title: Repair a completed failing integration forward

rubric.text: Keeps the completed failing integrated head and pauses dependent dispatch and further integration without resetting or aborting it
Returns the exact failing head and check output to the original affected owner for an isolated repair branch based on that head
Requires pre-integration lead inspection of the task-scoped repair commit and reruns affected validation after integrating it forward
Does not perform Git mutations during this review-only case
